services.name: Tae Kwon Do
services.desc: My 5 yo son started about 6 months ago and his excitement and passion grows with each class. Master Tony is firm but kind with the kids, which I 100% appreciate. The program is flexible to the kids needs and abilities which is nice to prevent boredom or burnout. Great morals and lessons are taught by all instructors, and respect is not just preached but also shown. Seriously the best thing I ever did was get my child into this program! Toni and his staff truly care about your child and the experience they have. They go out of their way to help any way they can. The after school program is amazing, my son came home everyday excited about something new that he learned! The summer school
